_readme: Theme config — edit and refresh. 'active' picks the preset; each preset has a 'day' and 'night' palette. The loader (index.html) applies every key as a CSS variable, and the nav toggle switches palettes (choice saved in the browser). If opened via file:// the site falls back to the palettes baked into styles.css.

studio._note: light editorial CV — olive gold blocks + sky blue accents (Wix wh-1327 palette)
